leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a WebSocket server to handle real-time connections for typing indicators.
Construct a client-side event handler to emit typing status changes.
Configure the server to broadcast typing events to all connected clients.
Implement a state variable to track and display the typing status of other users.
Apply conditional rendering to show or hide the typing indicator UI based on received events.
Integrate a debounce mechanism to optimize the frequency of typing event emissions.
Manipulate the DOM to dynamically update the indicator text with the name of the typing user.
